knowledge_gaps: The gate scales residual updates while leaving identity shortcuts intact; it does not necessarily suppress older interests or increase recent-item influence. That mechanism needs evidence.

Changing the gate, loss and negative sampler together confounds attribution. Specify sequential comparisons against the corrected baseline, including gate-only and uniform multi-negative variants, within the remaining GPU budget.

Reproduction requires gate dimensions and initialization, exact masked-mean normalization, candidate-pool size, moderate-hardness rank range, mining schedule, temperature, loss reduction, optimizer settings and candidate-shortfall handling.

The sampled-margin and catalog-ranking diagnostics use different candidate sets and sampled positions. Their difference motivates investigation but does not establish that insufficient negative hardness causes poor ranking.

Prefix-only exclusion leaves later training interactions eligible as false negatives. Document this tradeoff without using validation or test interactions, and specify deduplication across random and mined negatives.

Validation frequency, checkpoint selection, trial allocation and stopping rules are unspecified. Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category can overfit validation; report category results and paired uncertainty where host outputs permit.

Originality 4 is plausible, but potential 8 and difficulty 4 are subjective estimates. Benefits for compatibility and specific user intent remain unmeasured, and efficient per-position mining plus predictor and diagnostic integration may require substantial work.
